entities.name: The Early Modern Period
entities.label: Timeframe
entities.summary: The period (c. 1500-1800) encompassing the Renaissance, Reformation, Age of Exploration, Scientific Revolution, and Enlightenment — when Europe's intellectual, commercial, and military expansion reshaped global power relations. Printing, gunpowder, and oceanic navigation compressed distance and accelerated the exchange of ideas, goods, and microbes across civilizations.
